1. String 1 is 20 bytes: `"@@\x87\x87\x87b,,4\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff@\xbf@@P@"` followed by `\0` terminator

The builder then reuses String 1's offset for String 2. When String 2 is read back, it reads 121 bytes from String 1's data (which is only 20 bytes + null terminator = 21 bytes). This causes the heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in `EscapeString`.
